newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair Q1 cargo traffic down 2.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swissair Q1 cargo traffic down 2.5 pct.

text.p: Swiss Cargo, the cargo arm of Swissair, said first quarter traffic transported on its scheduled passenger routes worldwide totalled 342.3 million freight tonne kilometres (FTKs), down 2.5 percent on January-March 1996.
Swissair's cargo traffic transported on full-freighter flights in the period in question rose 118.5 percent on 1996 levels to 59,000 FTKs, a Swiss Cargo official said.
"Strong growth was largely due to the introduction of new full-freighter routes and additional frequencies on existing ones," he said.
In autumn 1996, Swiss Cargo launched a twice-weekly DC-10-30 freighter service between Geneva and Singapore which was upgraded to three weekly frequencies from end-March 1997
Swiss Cargo also operates scheduled freighter services from Basle to Chicago, Sao Paulo and Seoul.
